question.text: AD Category-I banks must operate within which limit for ETCD?

answer.text: Net Open Position Limit (NOPL), subject to exchange-stipulated limits

explanation.text: The Logic: AD Category-I banks may trade all permitted ETCD within their Net Open Position Limit (NOPL), subject to the limits stipulated by the respective exchanges. Synthetic USD-INR positions from cross-currency contracts must also remain within these position limits. The Trap: Banks DO have position limits for ETCD — they are not exempt from NOPL just because they are AD Category-I banks. Note: RBI may stipulate a separate NOPL sub-limit for the OTC market if required, but the ETCD NOPL itself is governed by exchange-stipulated limits.
